name: Sartorius
about: German maker of lab balances, liquid handling, lab water and filtration, and one of the big names in bioprocess (cell culture, bioreactors, single-use systems). In our guide it is the premium choice for weighing and for biopharma equipment.
known_for: Precision weighing: analytical, micro and ultra-micro balances
Built-in GLP / 21 CFR Part 11 features for pharma audits
Bioprocess and cell culture equipment (bioreactors, single-use mixing)
Lab water (arium) and filtration (Minisart, sterility testing)
known_lines: Cubis II (high-end balances, micro and ultra-micro)
Quintix and Secura (analytical and precision balances)
best_for: Pharma QC and R&D labs that face audits (USFDA, WHO-GMP)
Universities and research institutes with funded projects
pitch: Audit-ready: user management, audit trail and electronic signatures on the higher models
Automatic internal calibration (isoCAL) keeps results right when the room temperature changes
One brand for balance, pipette, water and filtration: one service partner
Resale value and life: a Sartorius balance often runs 10+ years

objections.then: Compare cost over 8-10 years: fewer breakdowns, no failed audits and no repeat tests. For a basic need offer Entris II or a lite brand from our guide instead of losing the client.

objections.if: Mettler Toledo is the market leader
objections.then: Both are top tier. Sartorius gives the same audit features, strong internal calibration and usually a better price for the same class. Ask for a side-by-side demo.

objections.if: We only need a simple balance
objections.then: Then do not oversell: offer Entris II or the economy brand of the guide, and keep Sartorius for the analytical / micro balance.

watch_out: Spares and service cost more than Indian brands
High-end models need a stable bench and room: tell the client before installation
